name: vault-scribe
description: An all-in-one notes manager for an Obsidian second brain: writes the daily note itself (changes and why, decisions, discussions, research and lookups), queues cross-project signals for review, shows a heads-up band, and guards dangerous writes.

vault_root.title: Vault folder
vault_root.description: Absolute path of your Obsidian vault (forward slashes are fine). Empty: the folder Claude Code was started in.

config_note.title: Config note
config_note.description: Vault-relative path of the note holding vault-scribe's settings (frontmatter) and project map (table). See README.md for a template.
